text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm not done yet! More... more! Let's 
enjoy this to the fullest!!

text_block_list.name: Heart & Messiah
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooooooooah...!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Whew! I was able to give it everything 
I've got right now!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Me too. I was able to bring out 
everything I had..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. We were... amazing. But—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the peak race of the 
Tiara... This is my—race...!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, no waaaaay!! Wait, crazy! I 
wanna do it too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna race like that too! And get lots 
and lots of praise~!"
choice_data_list:
(I can feel it, the passion in their 
hearts—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surely, Daring Heart and the others were 
the same back then. And so, the path of 
the Tiara continues on—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? But...—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ku-chan-senpai, where were you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah...―― Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Craft...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Did something happen during the race? 
You're not hurt, are you?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, nothing happened at all! 
Physically, I'm completely fine!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Then... Why? Why would—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
From your running... I couldn't feel any 
heat at all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Mr. Heart. Even though we 
talked about giving it the best run of our 
lives...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, but...! Heart-san, Messiah-san... 
Everyone who ran today... was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
As a fan of the Tiara races... I was so 
thrilled! That's why—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"A fire has definitely been lit. ...Inside 
my heart, too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Craft...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san, over New Year's... you told 
me, remember?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: “Saying you think of me... as a Queen.”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Those words. They made me... so very 
happy."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I used to just look up to others, and now, 
someone looks up to me...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I think Ms. Heart is a truly powerful 
queen, too."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"You have no idea how much your inner 
strength has carried me forward..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To you, who spoke so proudly of your 
dreams before your debut—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“To you, who has always called me... your 
rival—”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...You've kept chasing after me all this 
time. I truly admire you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"So, I promise! I'm going to come back 
stronger, just like you."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because I always want to be your 
rival...!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll redo my training from scratch 
for a bit. We've got the summer training 
camp coming up, too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So, our next battle will be in the autumn— 
at the same Mile GⅠ as today...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "How about the Mile Championship?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mile CS is the pinnacle of mile races, 
where those proud of their speed gather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A race where veterans of the Classic 
Triple Crown route and heavyweights of the 
Mile route clash. It will surely be a 
fiercer battle than ever before, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. I believe in Craft. That's 
why...!"
choice_data_list:
...This time for sure, we'll get to see 
the ultimate showdown.

...This time for sure, we'll get to see 
the ultimate showdown.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...! Yes, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft, I'll... polish myself to a finer 
sheen than ever before, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let us both become the ultimate Queens— 
and meet at the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! —It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The primary target race is set. However, 
the Mile Championship is in late 
November... I want to gain more practical 
experience before then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, regarding our next goal, 
may I make a suggestion?"
choice_data_list: Of course. Do you have a preference?
Of course. Do you have a preference?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: The Queen Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Stakes is a GIII race held in 
Sapporo at the height of summer. While the 
1800m distance certainly suits her—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The first time I learned your name, I just 
knew it was destiny!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Stakes— now that is truly a 
race befitting of me!"
choice_data_list: It's the name after all, huh.
Is it the name after all?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's not all, you know? Even 
in Hokkaido, summer races are harsh—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"If I polish my heart there... I'll become 
worthy of her when she returns stronger, 
won't I?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "The Queen Stakes! Fufu, let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Craft. —I'll be waiting for you!
